title: ligularia latihastata
intro: Ligularia latihastata, commonly known as Elephant Ear, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to China and Japan. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ligularia latihastata include its use as a diuretic and a treatment for fever, as well as its potential to soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
